translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Magi e ngeche mamoko mag Solomon, mane jo-Hezekia ruodh Juda ondiko.

content.text: Wamiyo Nyasaye duongʼ kuom gik ma opando;
to lero tiend weche en duongʼ ni ruodhi.
Mana kaka polo bor kendo piny tut,
e kaka chuny ruodhi ngʼeyo tek.
Ka ogol chilo kuom fedha,
to jatheth koro nigi gimoro mar theth;
ka ogol ngʼat marach e nyim ruoth,
eka kom ruodhe ibiro guro motegno e tim makare.
Kik imiri duongʼ iwuon e nyim ruoth,
kata bedo kar jomadongo,
nimar ber moloyo owachni niya, “Bi ka,”
moloyo ka igoli e nyim jomadongo.
Gima wangʼi oseneno kik ikel mapiyo kirikni e nyim od bura;
nimar ibiro timo angʼo achien ka jabuti oketi e wichkuot?
Ka iloso wach manie kindi gi jabuti,
to kik idhi ihul wach malingʼ-lingʼ mar ngʼato;
nono to ngʼat moro mowinji biro keti e wichkuot;
mi huma mari marach ok nogiki.
Wach mowach e kinde mowinjore,
chalo gi olemo mar dhahabu moketie tawo molos gi fedha.
Mana kaka tere mar dhahabu kata tigo mar dhahabu maber
e kaka siem mar ngʼat mariek mokwerogo ngʼat machiko ite.
Mana kaka ngʼich mar pe e kinde mar keyo,
e kaka jaote ma ja-adiera chalo ne ngʼat moore,
omoro chuny ruodhe.
Kaka boche polo gi yamo maonge koth,
e kaka ngʼat mawuorore gi mich ma ok dochiw.
Horuok mos nyalo loko chuny ruoth,
to lep mamuol nyalo toyo chogo.
Ka iyudo mor kich, to cham mana moromo,
mathoth ahinya, nyalo miyo ingʼogi.
Kik iter tiendi pile e od jabuti,
dhiyo kuno pile, biro miyo ochayi.
Mana kaka arungu kata ligangla; kata asere mabith,
e kaka ngʼatno machiwo neno ma ok adiera kuom ngʼat ma gidakgo machiegni.
Mana kaka lak marach kata tielo mongʼol
e kaka keto geno kuom jogo ma ok jo-adiera e kinde mag chandruok.
Mana ka ngʼat ma lonyo law midongʼ duk e ndalo ngʼich,
kata kaka olo chumbi e adhola,
e kaka ngʼat ma wero wende ne chuny mool.
Ka jasiki odenyo, to miye chiemo ocham;
ka riyo oloye, miye pi omodhi.
Ka itimo kamano, ibiro choko chuk mach maliel e wiye,
kendo Jehova Nyasaye biro miyi pok.
Kaka yamb nyandwat kelo koth,
e kaka lep mafuongʼo wach kelo miero.
Ber dak e kona mar wi ot
moloyo dak gi dhako maralep.
Mana kaka pi mangʼich chalo ne chuny mool,
e kaka wach maber moa e piny mabor chalo.
Mana kaka soko motimo chwodho kata aora moduwore chalo
e kaka ngʼat makare machiwo thuolo ne jaricho.
Ok ber chamo mor kich mathoth,
kata ok en gima longʼo mondo ngʼato odwar luor monego miye owuon.
Mana kaka dala maduongʼ ma ohingane omukore mogore piny
e kaka ngʼatno ma ok nyal ritore owuon.
